newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Stock Exchange elects 10 governors.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Stock Exchange elects 10 governors.

text.p: Chicago Stock Exchange (CHX) members elected 10 governors to the 29-member Board of Governors at the CHX annual election Tuesday.
Terence Hurley, director of equity markets and a floor broker for Merrill Lynch, Pierce, Fenner & Smith, was re-elected CHX vice chairman for another two-year term.

Members elected for terms expiring in April 2000 include Kenneth Lyall, Thomas Williams, John Kayser, Cynthia Carlson, Sidney Dorr and C. Michael Viviano. Non-member governors, whose terms also expire in April 2000, elected Tuesday include exchange chairman David Fox, Edward Massie and David Goldberg.
